besluite.fout: Intransitive 'wys' for abilities becoming visible reads stiff and English-shaped.
besluite.rede: 'na vore kom' is the natural Afrikaans for this and keeps the meaning exactly.

besluite.fout: Same stiff intransitive 'wys' as the previous sentence.
besluite.rede: Matches change 1 so the two contrasting sentences stay parallel; meaning unchanged.

besluite.fout: By the AWS rule a comma belongs before 'of' joining 'jy doen' and 'jy wil'.
besluite.rede: This sentence mirrors the shared belangstelling definition word for word, and a comma here makes three comma-'of' clauses so the protected 'of jy dit nou al kan doen of nie' can read as a third alternative; the writer must settle study text and definition together.

besluite.fout: 'Jy kan graag ... kyk' is wooden, and in a lesson where 'kan' means ability it can be misread as a skill.
besluite.rede: 'Jy kyk dalk graag' keeps the possibility, reads naturally and removes the ability reading.
'iets waarby jy die tyd vergeet' is a sound Afrikaans construction; the proposal is longer and only different.

besluite.fout: A bare main clause embedded after 'dat jy sien' is clumsy.
besluite.rede: 'sien hoe jy beter word' still means noticing your own improvement and reads smoothly.

besluite.fout: Figurative 'netjies' is followed at once by literal 'netjies skryf', an echo that jars for a Grade 6 reader.
besluite.rede: 'so eenvoudig' carries the same sense and removes the clash with the next sentence.

besluite.fout: 'goed netjies' is a colloquial stacked intensifier that can be misread as 'goed, netjies'.
besluite.rede: 'baie netjies' says the same skill plainly and keeps the contrast with not liking it.

besluite.fout: 'met tyd' copies English 'with time' where Afrikaans has 'mettertyd', and bare 'gewoon' can read as 'plain'.
besluite.rede: Uses the fixed expression and makes the reassuring 'quite normal' sense clear without adding information.
The resources listed include people in your family and street, so 'van hulle' fits and reads naturally.
The shared preposition and possessive read clearly enough; repeating 'in jou' is a lateral move that adds length.

besluite.fout: 'het dit ook baie om te leer' copies 'has a lot to offer' and literally makes the internet the one learning.
besluite.rede: The proposal makes the learner the one who learns, keeps the condition, and leaves the 'saam met 'n grootmens' instruction and its 'dit' intact.

besluite.fout: 'nog nie verskil sien nie' lacks the article Afrikaans needs here.
besluite.rede: Adding 'n is a plain grammar fix with no change in meaning.
